scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let t;try{t=parseInt(fs.readFileSync('.env','utf8').match(/TILES_PER_PAGE\\s*=\\s*(\\d+)/)[1],10)}catch(e){const m=fs.readFileSync('src/config/appConfig.ts','utf8').match(/TILES_PER_PAGE.*\\?\\?\\s*'(\\d+)'/)||fs.readFileSync('src/config/appConfig.ts','utf8').match(/tilesPerPage:\\s*(\\d+)/);t=m?parseInt(m[1],10):16}if(t<4||t>100){console.error('tilesPerPage must be 4–100, got '+t);process.exit(1)}console.log('Config valid: tilesPerPage='+t)"
scripts.build: tsc && cp index.html dist/ && mkdir -p dist/src && cp src/*.css dist/src/ && (cp -r public dist/ 2>/dev/null || true)
